sample_unit: model-generated responses (30 scenarios x 2 models x 2 languages)

links.outcome: Recognition of emergency ENT scenarios and three-category triage accuracy in Turkish and English
links.effect: Gemini 3 Pro identified all 18 emergency scenarios in both languages; triage correct in 58/60 (96.7%) for Gemini and 55/60 (91.7%) for ChatGPT 5.2; no significant differences (p > 0.05).
links.quote: Gemini 3 Pro correctly identified all 18 emergency scenarios in both language conditions.

screen.reason: The study tests LLM diagnostic and triage accuracy and safety scores across languages using 30 simulated ENT clinical scenarios, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
